title: First Steps
keywords: Turn in First Steps after defeating 5 Hens to receive your first class skill book and potions. Open your bag and double-click the book to learn.

title: Meet the Butcher
keywords: Speak to the Butcher in the village.

title: Provisions for the Road
keywords: Hunt Deer for 5 pieces of Venison and bring them to the Butcher.

title: The Blacksmith’s Test
keywords: Put your class skill to use: defeat a total of 10 Scarecrows, Hooking Cats or Raking Cats in Bichon to earn equipment and supplies. Taoists also receive a Healing skill book, usable at level 7. The blacksmith trial rewards your second class skill book. Use it from your bag at level 5. Heavy Strike books are quest rewards only and no longer drop.

title: Planks for the Ferryman
keywords: Deliver the planks to the Ferryman by the river in Bichon.

title: Dragonroot
keywords: Defeat Omas and press F to pick up Longyang Grass. Turn it in to the Peddler for a Town Scroll; keep it for your return from the tomb.

title: Scorpion Tail Remedy
keywords: Use the village or Bichon station to teleport near the tomb entrance, then enter Floor 1. Defeat a scorpion, pick up its tail and bring it to the Peddler.

title: Find Xiaobao
keywords: Enter Oma Cave from Bichon and find Xiaobao on 2F.

title: Good News for the Blacksmith
keywords: Return to the village and tell the Blacksmith that Xiaobao is safe.

title: Medicine for Old Wang
keywords: Deliver the Peddler’s medicine powder to Old Wang.

title: Trouble in the Tomb
keywords: Defeat the Bone Elite on Oma Cave 2F.

title: Secrets of the Tomb
keywords: Obtain the Tomb Manuscript from Zombies in the Mine. Old Wang can send you to the mine entrance.

title: The Temple Entrance
keywords: A Temple Scroll grants entry to Wooma Hall. One scroll is consumed each time. Defeat the Bone Elite on Oma Cave 2F to replenish your supply.

title: The Wooma Emblem
keywords: Obtain a Mysterious Emblem from a Wooma Guardian or Wooma Taurus. Bring it to the Lord of Bichon to receive a Medal of Honour.

title: Clear the Dungeon
keywords: Travel through the Mine, Dead Mine and Connecting Passage to Dungeon 1F. Defeat any 30 monsters there.

title: The Zuma Letter
keywords: Cross the Death Abyss and Crossroads to reach Zuma Temple. Dark Zuma Archers carry the secret letter.

title: The Scholar’s Translation
keywords: Find the Mysterious Scholar in the Mine and ask him to decipher the letter.

title: Report to the Lord
keywords: Return to Bichon and bring the scholar’s findings to the Lord of Bichon.

title: Venomous Spider Silk
keywords: Enter Red Moon Valley from the Crossroads. Collect 5 bundles of Venomous Spider Silk from the three spider species there.

title: Pandora’s Box
keywords: Defeat a Blood Zombie in Red Moon Valley to obtain Pandora’s Box.

title: The Five Fragments
keywords: Collect fragments from Zuma Taurus, White Boar, Wooma Taurus, Bone Elite and the Ghoul in the Mine. Combine them in Pandora’s Box to make an Ancient Relic, then hand it in.

title: Breaking the Seal
keywords: Bring the Ancient Relic to the Lord of Bichon to receive Demon-Sealing Water.

title: The Demon in the Palace
keywords: Ask the Lord of Bichon to send you to Bichon Palace. Use Demon-Sealing Water to summon the Ancient Demon and obtain a Black Feather.

title: Beyond the First Gate
keywords: Pass through Bichon’s south gate and find the Frontier Veteran beyond the first gate.

title: Trouble at the Frontier
keywords: Defeat a total of 25 Oma Warriors or Yobs beyond the first gate.

title: Foxes of Mourning Moon
keywords: Pass through the Blood Cavern to Mourning Moon Mountain and defeat 25 Foxes.

title: Heart of Lava
keywords: Travel to Lava Hell, defeat the Lava Demon and obtain the Heart of Lava.

title: The Frozen Hero
keywords: Speak to the Frozen Hero near the Frontier Veteran.

title: The Manor Veteran
keywords: Return to Bichon. Ask the Lord of Bichon to send you to the Manor, then speak to the veteran there.

title: A Token of Passage
keywords: Obtain a Hidden Realm Token from Wooma Taurus, Zuma Taurus or the Evil Ape in the Sleeping Grounds.

title: Trial of the Hidden Realm
keywords: Enter Hidden Realm 1F and defeat 25 Vengeful Zombies, then report to the Hidden Realm Keeper.

title: Find Mu Rushuang
keywords: Pass through Hidden Realm 2F to reach 3F and speak to Mu Rushuang.

title: The Five Ancient Scriptures
keywords: Collect one Ancient Scripture from each of the five floors of the Hidden Realm. Mu Rushuang can send you back to 1F.

title: The Illusion Minotaur King
keywords: Defeat the Illusion Minotaur King on Hidden Realm 3F to open the way to 4F.

title: The Secret Ghoul
keywords: Defeat the Secret Ghoul on 4F, then report to the guide to open the way to 5F.

title: Passage to the Snowfield
keywords: With all five scriptures collected, speak to Mu Rushuang to unlock travel to the Snowfield.

title: A New Chapter in the Snow
keywords: Ask Mu Rushuang to send you to the Snowfield, then find Mu Ruxue.

title: Wooma Water
keywords: Bring 10 portions of Wooma Water to the Demon Merchant to receive a Wooma weapon for your class.

title: Fencing
keywords: Warrior Improves swordsmanship and Accuracy.

title: Slaying
keywords: Warrior Channels inner strength into a powerful strike.

title: Thrusting
keywords: Warrior A piercing sword strike that ignores the secondary target’s Defence.

title: Half Moon
keywords: Warrior Sweeps enemies in a frontal arc with sword energy.

title: Flaming Sword
keywords: Warrior Charges your next strike with fire.

title: Lion Roar
keywords: Warrior Unleashes a roar that paralyses eligible nearby enemies.

title: Steadfast
keywords: Warrior Reduces the chance of flinching when hit.

title: Berserker
keywords: Warrior Improves weapon mastery and attack effectiveness.

title: Blazing Sword
keywords: Warrior Unleashes fire-charged sword energy along a line ahead.

title: Sky Cleaver
keywords: Warrior Strikes enemies in a straight line with sword energy.

title: Blood Dragon
keywords: Warrior Increases Attack Speed and critical-hit chance.

title: Diamond Body
keywords: Warrior Uses inner energy to absorb or reflect damage. Advanced training increases Max HP and Health Potion recovery.

title: Whirlwind Slash
keywords: Warrior Sweeps all surrounding enemies with twin sword arcs and may briefly stun lower-level foes.

title: Flash Slash
keywords: Warrior Dashes forward with an explosive strike.

title: Heavy Strike
keywords: Warrior Every fourth damaging normal melee hit deals 150% damage. Resets after 8 seconds without a hit. Replaced when Slaying is learned.

title: Fire Ball
keywords: Wizard Hurls a fireball at one enemy. Damage grows with skill rank.

title: Electric Shock
keywords: Wizard Attempts to tame eligible monsters as allies. See the rank details for level limits.

title: Great Fire Ball
keywords: Wizard Hurls a powerful fireball. Damage grows with skill rank.

title: Thunder Bolt
keywords: Wizard Calls down lightning to strike an enemy.

title: Fire Bang
keywords: Wizard Engulfs a small area around the target in intense flames.

title: Fire Wall
keywords: Wizard Creates a wall of fire that burns enemies who enter it.

title: Frost Crunch
keywords: Wizard Launches a ball of ice that can freeze enemies. Frozen enemies take more fire damage.

title: Thunder Storm
keywords: Wizard Strikes surrounding enemies with a lightning storm, dealing the most damage at its centre.

title: Magic Shield
keywords: Wizard Creates a protective shield whose strength and duration increase with skill rank. Advanced ranks limit single-hit damage and can negate damage at low HP.

title: Ice Storm
keywords: Wizard Calls an ice storm over the target area.

title: Flame Disruptor
keywords: Wizard Strikes a single enemy with dragon fire, ignoring part of its Magic Defence.

title: Meteor Strike
keywords: Wizard Calls repeated meteor strikes on enemies locked within the casting area.

title: Ice Flame
keywords: Wizard Attacks enemies with pillars of ice.

title: Dragon Flame
keywords: Wizard Scorches enemies within an area over time.

title: Abyss
keywords: Wizard Increases magic damage at the cost of higher MP consumption.

title: Chain Thunder
keywords: Wizard Sends powerful lightning leaping between enemies.

title: Healing
keywords: Taoist Restore your health or an owned summon’s health. On desktop, hover your summon to heal it; an enemy or empty ground heals yourself. On mobile, select your summon then tap the skill.

title: Spirit Sword
keywords: Taoist Focuses spiritual power to improve Accuracy.

title: Poisoning
keywords: Taoist Poisons enemies, reduces their Defence and prevents automatic HP recovery. On desktop, poison the enemy monster under the cursor without locking on first. With no monster under the cursor, do not cast. Mobile keeps touch targeting.

title: Soul Fire Ball
keywords: Taoist Strikes an enemy with a spirit talisman. Advanced ranks ignore part of its defence.

title: Summon Skeleton
keywords: Taoist Summons a Skeleton companion.

title: Hiding
keywords: Taoist Conceals you from monsters for a time. Duration scales with skill rank and Taoism.

title: Blessed Armour
keywords: Taoist Raises Defence and Magic Defence.

title: Mass Healing
keywords: Taoist Heals allies within an area.

title: Summon Shinsu
keywords: Taoist Summons a powerful, fire-breathing Shinsu companion.

title: Poison Cloud
keywords: Taoist Spreads a cloud that deals repeated damage to enemies in an area and may poison them.

title: Advanced Summon
keywords: Taoist Summons a powerful, fire-breathing Ancient Shinsu companion.

title: Beast Armour
keywords: Taoist Enhances an Ancient Shinsu’s combat stats.

title: Innate Qi
keywords: Taoist Gradually restores HP after taking damage and strengthens soul-element spells.

title: Summon Tiger
keywords: Taoist Summons a powerful White Tiger companion.

title: Summon Moon Spirit
keywords: Taoist Summons ranged Moon Spirit companions.

title: Ghost Burn
keywords: Taoist Reduces the target’s Attack.

title: Summon Spirit Servant
keywords: Taoist Summons a spirit with ranged talisman attacks. Attack and defence scale with owner Taoism. Shares the basic summon slot with Skeleton. Shares owner experience while present, up to level 7. Living re-summons and saves retain growth; death resets level and XP. After 5 seconds out of combat, restores 1% max HP every 5 seconds. Hover your spirit on desktop, or select it on mobile, then cast Healing. Receive the book after First Steps and learn it from your bag; no upgrade books required
